Cost Per Dose: 150eb (Expensive)

A Maelstrom modification to typical Black Lace that vaporizes it to minimize side effects in exchange for it only working with certain kinds of inhalers and metabolizing much quicker, resulting in a shorter high.

⋙ PRIMARY EFFECT ⋘

  • Lasts 1 hour.
  • User takes 1d6 Humanity Loss that is returned if the user isn’t affected by S-KEEF’s Secondary Effect.
  • For the duration of the Primary Effect, the user ignores the effects of the Seriously Wounded Wound State.

⋙ SECONDARY EFFECT (DV17) ⋘

  • Humanity Loss from S-KEEF’s Primary Effect isn’t returned.
  • If the user wasn’t already addicted to S-KEEF, they are now. While addicted, unless the user is currently experiencing the Primary Effect of S-KEEF, their REF is reduced by 2.

⋙ SPECIAL FEATURES⋘

  • This drug can only be consumed via a Maxdoc Inhaler, and is not compatible with Airhypos, Arrowhypo Ammunition, Multihypos, or similar devices. It can still be loaded into Airburst Ammunition and other aerosol-based application methods.

NOTE: This is based on how Dum Dum in 2077 calls his specific batch of Black Lace ‘S-KEEF’ and directly mentions the aerosol version reducing its downsides.

Cost: 150eb (Expensive) per dose
Type: Street Drug

Foundry notes:

  • While addicted, switch on the "S-KEEF Addiction" effect.
  • When an addicted character doses, use "S-KEEF Addicted Primary" instead of the normal primary effect; it cancels the withdrawal penalties for the duration.
  • Stat and skill changes are automated; caps, minimums, durations, and everything else are not.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Street Drugs).
